MB: why only so little with 0 J nucleotides? All primers covering N1 in V-D-J rearrangements must have 0 nucleotides.
Answer: V-D-J rearrangements: 109/249 -> primer covering only N1 (not N2): 35/109 -> 6/35 with 0 nt in J
